items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...It was written by Paddy Chayevsky. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah, I remember that. I didn't see it, I remember it.

ctx.x: It was just shown on TV a few weeks ago and it won an Oscar about two years ago.

There was one really interesting statement, the plot of it is of a fourth television network and how they talk about audience manipulation and what is done in a really outrageous sense to gain an audience. It was written by Paddy Chayevsky.
Oh yeah, I remember that. I didn't see it, I remember it.
